milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward the dark oak fence gate at the garden entrance and face it, confirming they have visually located it. The gate is at spawn-relative (0, 1, 5). max_distance=5 ensures the player has actively walked toward it from spawn (~5 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the gate.

Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='block', object='potted_blue_orchid', max_count=0) because this is a mine/break task — the potted_blue_orchid block at (0, 2, 8) should no longer exist after the player breaks it. A generous box of ±3 XZ and ±3 Y around the orchid's position ensures the check captures the exact block location. This is preferred over inventory_has because mining a flower pot drops two separate items (flower_pot + blue_orchid) and the task is specifically about removing the block from the world.
